titulo: Quiz — The ticket, and whether this one needs a second one
introPt: A traveller settles a platform in four minutes and five questions.
cenario: A station concourse, ticket in hand, four minutes to departure.

dialogo.pt: Do I need a limited-express ticket?

dialogo.es: 新幹線は要ります。でも普通電車なら要りませんよ。
dialogo.pt: On the Shinkansen, yes. But on a local train, no.
dialogo.tts: 新幹線は要ります。でも普通電車なら要りませんよ。

dialogo.es: 十二番線はどこですか？
dialogo.tts: 十二番線はどこですか？

dialogo.es: 十二番線、十四時三十五分発です。
dialogo.pt: Platform twelve, departure at fourteen thirty-five.
dialogo.tts: 十二番線、十四時三十五分発です。

perguntas.pergunta: On JR, how many tickets does a Shinkansen or limited-express (tokkyuu) train need?
opcoes: One — the fare ticket covers it
Two — a basic fare ticket (joushaken) plus a limited-express ticket (tokkyuuken)
None, if you have an IC card
perguntas.explica: At the gate the two tickets often go in together and both come back out. Take them both.

perguntas.pergunta: What does an ordinary local or rapid train need?
opcoes: Two tickets, same as the fast trains
Only the fare, or a tap of an IC card
perguntas.explica: The second ticket is only for the Shinkansen and tokkyuu — exactly the fast trains a visitor most wants.

perguntas.pergunta: The exit gate will not open. What has happened?
opcoes: You have been fined on the spot
Honest underpayment — settle the difference at the fare-adjustment machine (seisanki) and walk through
perguntas.explica: This is not a penalty. You top up the difference at the norikoshi seisan machine or the window, unlike a European on-the-spot fine.

perguntas.pergunta: What does «bansen» mean in an announcement?
perguntas.explica: Catch the number and the word bansen and let the rest of the sentence go.

perguntas.pergunta: With a Japan Rail Pass, can you ride the fastest Nozomi and Mizuho services?
opcoes: Only by paying a separate supplement — the Pass alone does not cover them
Only in non-reserved cars for free
perguntas.explica: Since the October 2023 price rise, Pass holders ride Nozomi and Mizuho only with a paid supplement.
